descriptions.zh: 我们从[Root.GetName]上热带森林收集到的初始数据表明，这里有一些异常的东西。
descriptions.en: The initial data gathered from the tropical forests of [Root.GetName] indicate that something is out of the ordinary.

sections.zh: 我们从[Root.GetName]上热带森林收集到的初始数据表明，这里有一些异常的东西。
sections.en: The initial data gathered from the tropical forests of [Root.GetName] indicate that something is out of the ordinary.

descriptions.zh: 我们对小行星的成分进行了初步的分析，有了一些有趣的发现。
descriptions.en: Initial analysis of the asteroid's composition points towards potentially interesting finds.

sections.zh: 我们对小行星的成分进行了初步的分析，有了一些有趣的发现。
sections.en: Initial analysis of the asteroid's composition points towards potentially interesting finds.

descriptions.zh: 经过初步探测，我们在求救频率中发现了异常的信号。
descriptions.en: Our initial scans have caught an irregular signal reminiscent of our own distress patterns.

sections.zh: 经过初步探测，我们在求救频率中发现了异常的信号。
sections.en: Our initial scans have caught an irregular signal reminiscent of our own distress patterns.

descriptions.zh: 在扫描小行星带的时候，我们的科研小队发现了一些不寻常的东西。
descriptions.en: While scanning the asteroid belt our science team found some sort of irregularity.

sections.zh: 在扫描小行星带的时候，我们的科研小队发现了一些不寻常的东西。
sections.en: While scanning the asteroid belt our science team found some sort of irregularity.

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]上矿物的成分和预期并不相符。
descriptions.en: The mineral composition of [Root.GetName] does not match projections.

sections.zh: [Root.GetName]上矿物的成分和预期并不相符。
sections.en: The mineral composition of [Root.GetName] does not match projections.

descriptions.zh: 沙漠星球[Root.GetName]似乎埋藏着一些秘密。
descriptions.en: The desert planet [Root.GetName] seems to conceal some buried secrets.

sections.zh: 沙漠星球[Root.GetName]似乎埋藏着一些秘密。
sections.en: The desert planet [Root.GetName] seems to conceal some buried secrets.

descriptions.zh: 我们探测到了奇怪的宇宙射线，科学专员要求对其进行调查。
descriptions.en: We have detected odd radiation that our Science Officer demands to investigate.

sections.zh: 我们探测到了奇怪的宇宙射线，科学专员要求对其进行调查。
sections.en: We have detected odd radiation that our Science Officer demands to investigate.

descriptions.zh: 在对[Root.GetName]进行扫描之后，我们得到了一些关于地表下事物的微妙读数。
descriptions.en: Scans of [Root.GetName] return subtle readings of something beneath the surface.

sections.zh: 在对[Root.GetName]进行扫描之后，我们得到了一些关于地表下事物的微妙读数。
sections.en: Scans of [Root.GetName] return subtle readings of something beneath the surface.

descriptions.zh: 科学专员发现了一个异常现象。需要进行更广泛的探测，也许会有大量新发现。
descriptions.en: Our Science Officer has found an anomaly. It will require extensive probing, but could garner a substantial find.

sections.zh: 科学专员发现了一个异常现象。需要进行更广泛的探测，也许会有大量新发现。
sections.en: Our Science Officer has found an anomaly. It will require extensive probing, but could garner a substantial find.

descriptions.zh: 扫描这颗恒星时发现一个小型物体。它处在高速轨道上，体积又实在太小，令探测器难以仔细分辨。
descriptions.en: Scanning the star unveils a small object in rapid orbit. Its small size and high velocity make it difficult for our sensors to isolate.

sections.zh: 扫描这颗恒星时发现一个小型物体。它处在高速轨道上，体积又实在太小，令探测器难以仔细分辨。
sections.en: Scanning the star unveils a small object in rapid orbit. Its small size and high velocity make it difficult for our sensors to isolate.

descriptions.zh:
我们观测了大量小行星[Root.GetName]，有了一些发现……

还有待进一步的调查。
descriptions.en:
Observing the massive asteroid [Root.GetName], we have found...

Something. Further investigation is warranted.

sections.zh:
我们观测了大量小行星[Root.GetName]，有了一些发现……

还有待进一步的调查。
sections.en:
Observing the massive asteroid [Root.GetName], we have found...

Something. Further investigation is warranted.

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]上的浓密丛林里似乎隐藏着有趣的东西。
descriptions.en: [Root.GetName] appears to hold something of interest deep within its dense jungles.

sections.zh: [Root.GetName]上的浓密丛林里似乎隐藏着有趣的东西。
sections.en: [Root.GetName] appears to hold something of interest deep within its dense jungles.

descriptions.zh: 我们在贫瘠的[From.GetPlanetMoon]上发现了异乎寻常的东西。似乎有人在此之前就来过这里了。具体情况有待进一步调查。
descriptions.en: We have detected something out of the ordinary on the arid [From.GetPlanetMoon]. It seems like somebody has been here before us. Further investigation is needed.

sections.zh: 我们在贫瘠的[From.GetPlanetMoon]上发现了异乎寻常的东西。似乎有人在此之前就来过这里了。具体情况有待进一步调查。
sections.en: We have detected something out of the ordinary on the arid [From.GetPlanetMoon]. It seems like somebody has been here before us. Further investigation is needed.

descriptions.zh: 这颗微型行星上的森林预示着有趣的发现。
descriptions.en: The forests on this planetoid bear promises of interesting finds.

sections.zh: 这颗微型行星上的森林预示着有趣的发现。
sections.en: The forests on this planetoid bear promises of interesting finds.

descriptions.zh: 这颗星球上面有人造的建筑，说明上面曾有过一段失落的历史。
descriptions.en: There appears to be deliberately-crafted structures on the planet's surface, pointing toward a past long forgotten.

sections.zh: 这颗星球上面有人造的建筑，说明上面曾有过一段失落的历史。
sections.en: There appears to be deliberately-crafted structures on the planet's surface, pointing toward a past long forgotten.

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]上的高温尚在预料范围之内。但是，我们的队伍还收集到了很多反常数据。在完成最终报告之前，还需要深入研究。
descriptions.en: The scorching heat of [Root.GetName] is within the expected range. However, there is more unusual data still being collected by our team. Further study is needed before a final report can be filed.

sections.zh: [Root.GetName]上的高温尚在预料范围之内。但是，我们的队伍还收集到了很多反常数据。在完成最终报告之前，还需要深入研究。
sections.en: The scorching heat of [Root.GetName] is within the expected range. However, there is more unusual data still being collected by our team. Further study is needed before a final report can be filed.

descriptions.zh: 我们的科研团队调查到了一些“谜团”。需要得到这种现象的更多细节，才能真正解开这个谜团。
descriptions.en: Our survey has uncovered something that can only be described by the science team as "mystical." We would need to investigate the phenomenon in more detail to unshroud this mystery.

sections.zh: 我们的科研团队调查到了一些“谜团”。需要得到这种现象的更多细节，才能真正解开这个谜团。
sections.en: Our survey has uncovered something that can only be described by the science team as "mystical." We would need to investigate the phenomenon in more detail to unshroud this mystery.

descriptions.zh: 这片核废土是这里逝去文明的佐证。我们应该进一步调查那些探测器探测到的有活动迹象的地点。
descriptions.en: The nuclear wasteland is evidently a sign of a previous civilization. Our scanners are picking up activity at certain locations that we should investigate.

sections.zh: 这片核废土是这里逝去文明的佐证。我们应该进一步调查那些探测器探测到的有活动迹象的地点。
sections.en: The nuclear wasteland is evidently a sign of a previous civilization. Our scanners are picking up activity at certain locations that we should investigate.

descriptions.zh: 我们发现有一颗行星含有大量严重衰变的放射性同位素。建议进行更深入的调查。
descriptions.en: We have discovered a planet containing large quantities of heavily decayed radioactive isotopes. Further investigation is warranted.

sections.zh: 我们发现有一颗行星含有大量严重衰变的放射性同位素。建议进行更深入的调查。
sections.en: We have discovered a planet containing large quantities of heavily decayed radioactive isotopes. Further investigation is warranted.

descriptions.zh: [From.GetPlanetMoon]并非气候宜人之地，但如果我们最初的侦测结果无误，它上面可能有一些珍贵资源。
descriptions.en: The [From.GetPlanetMoon] is not the most welcoming of places, but if our initial scans are any indication it could hold some valuable resources.

sections.zh: [From.GetPlanetMoon]并非气候宜人之地，但如果我们最初的侦测结果无误，它上面可能有一些珍贵资源。
sections.en: The [From.GetPlanetMoon] is not the most welcoming of places, but if our initial scans are any indication it could hold some valuable resources.

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetName]有显著的水体，同时其大陆部分是了无生机的荒漠。已授权进一步研究。
descriptions.en: [Root.GetName] has significant bodies of water, and yet its landmasses are lifeless deserts. Further study is warranted.

sections.zh: [Root.GetName]有显著的水体，同时其大陆部分是了无生机的荒漠。已授权进一步研究。
sections.en: [Root.GetName] has significant bodies of water, and yet its landmasses are lifeless deserts. Further study is warranted.

descriptions.zh: 我们的科学专员发现，在[root.GetName]的日冕附近出现的疑似传感器故障在重启之后仍然留存在。已批准进一步研究。
descriptions.en: Our scientists have discovered what first appeared to be a sensor malfunction near the corona of [root.GetName], however it's still there after rebooting. A closer look is warranted.

sections.zh: 我们的科学专员发现，在[root.GetName]的日冕附近出现的疑似传感器故障在重启之后仍然留存在。已批准进一步研究。
sections.en: Our scientists have discovered what first appeared to be a sensor malfunction near the corona of [root.GetName], however it's still there after rebooting. A closer look is warranted.

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName]环绕红矮星的奇特轨道使得这颗行星处于潮汐锁定的状态，具有进一步调查的价值。
descriptions.en: [From.GetName]'s peculiar orbit around its red dwarf star renders the planet tidally locked, and potentially worthy of further investigation.

sections.zh: [From.GetName]环绕红矮星的奇特轨道使得这颗行星处于潮汐锁定的状态，具有进一步调查的价值。
sections.en: [From.GetName]'s peculiar orbit around its red dwarf star renders the planet tidally locked, and potentially worthy of further investigation.

descriptions.zh: 在[From.GetName]的周边地区探测到异常的时空波动。需要进一步分析。
descriptions.en: Unusual fluctuations in spacetime have been detected in the vicinity of [From.GetName]. Further analysis is advised.

sections.zh: 在[From.GetName]的周边地区探测到异常的时空波动。需要进一步分析。
sections.en: Unusual fluctuations in spacetime have been detected in the vicinity of [From.GetName]. Further analysis is advised.

descriptions.zh: 一座信标围绕着[From.GetName]，召唤着路过的人靠近。在这个小行星上，有一座巨大的金属碑塔赫然耸立，它的作用尚不明确。
descriptions.en: A signal beacon orbits [From.GetName], beckoning travelers nearer. On the asteroid, a giant metal monolith looms, its purpose unknown.

sections.zh: 一座信标围绕着[From.GetName]，召唤着路过的人靠近。在这个小行星上，有一座巨大的金属碑塔赫然耸立，它的作用尚不明确。
sections.en: A signal beacon orbits [From.GetName], beckoning travelers nearer. On the asteroid, a giant metal monolith looms, its purpose unknown.

descriptions.zh: 从小行星带取回的岩石样本包含大量的生物组织，这让人始料未及。
descriptions.en: Rock samples retrieved from the asteroid belt unexpectedly contain a large amount of biological tissue.

sections.zh: 从小行星带取回的岩石样本包含大量的生物组织，这让人始料未及。
sections.en: Rock samples retrieved from the asteroid belt unexpectedly contain a large amount of biological tissue.

descriptions.zh: 扫描发现了一片来源不确定的残骸场。这会和在此恒星系中巡逻的被抛弃的科研船有关吗？
descriptions.en: Scans have identified a debris field of uncertain origin. Could this have something to do with the abandoned science ship patrolling the system?

sections.zh: 扫描发现了一片来源不确定的残骸场。这会和在此恒星系中巡逻的被抛弃的科研船有关吗？
sections.en: Scans have identified a debris field of uncertain origin. Could this have something to do with the abandoned science ship patrolling the system?

descriptions.zh: 这是一片古战场。在此处，古老的帝国们为了争夺星海的至上霸权相互碾轧。现在，帝国已然是过往云烟，只剩下这些挂着旗帜的战舰残骸。
descriptions.en: A long-forgotten battlefield where ancient empires once fought for supremacy of the galaxy - now all that remains are the vessels of those who fought under their banners.

sections.zh: 这是一片古战场。在此处，古老的帝国们为了争夺星海的至上霸权相互碾轧。现在，帝国已然是过往云烟，只剩下这些挂着旗帜的战舰残骸。
sections.en: A long-forgotten battlefield where ancient empires once fought for supremacy of the galaxy - now all that remains are the vessels of those who fought under their banners.

descriptions.zh: 这颗行星发射出怪异的磁力波，与我们目前为止所知的一切均大不相同，几乎可以说它就像想要与我们沟通一般。唯有对这一不同寻常的现象进行调查方才符合逻辑——我们可能遇上了一个行星大小生物形态的绝佳个例。
descriptions.en: This planet emits strange magnetic waves, quite unlike anything we have seen so far, almost as if it is trying to communicate with us. It is only logical to investigate this unusual phenomenon - we may have just encountered an extraordinary example of life on a planetary scale.

sections.zh: 这颗行星发射出怪异的磁力波，与我们目前为止所知的一切均大不相同，几乎可以说它就像想要与我们沟通一般。唯有对这一不同寻常的现象进行调查方才符合逻辑——我们可能遇上了一个行星大小生物形态的绝佳个例。
sections.en: This planet emits strange magnetic waves, quite unlike anything we have seen so far, almost as if it is trying to communicate with us. It is only logical to investigate this unusual phenomenon - we may have just encountered an extraordinary example of life on a planetary scale.

descriptions.zh: 科研团队在调查[From.GetName]的时候发现了一处来自行星的冰层之下的异常热信号。
descriptions.en: Whilst surveying [From.GetName], the science team detected unusual heat signatures coming from below the frozen surface of the planet.

sections.zh: 科研团队在调查[From.GetName]的时候发现了一处来自行星的冰层之下的异常热信号。
sections.en: Whilst surveying [From.GetName], the science team detected unusual heat signatures coming from below the frozen surface of the planet.

descriptions.zh: 这个星系中有大量的超空间航道。通常情况下，我们会认为它们太小了，宇宙飞船无法在其中航行，但是它们的数量本身就很惊人。
descriptions.en: There are an unusual amount of hyperlanes in this system. Usually, we would dismiss these as too small to facilitate a spaceship, but the sheer amount is intriguing in and of itself.

sections.zh: 这个星系中有大量的超空间航道。通常情况下，我们会认为它们太小了，宇宙飞船无法在其中航行，但是它们的数量本身就很惊人。
sections.en: There are an unusual amount of hyperlanes in this system. Usually, we would dismiss these as too small to facilitate a spaceship, but the sheer amount is intriguing in and of itself.

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName]地表冰层的最上层覆盖着规模异常巨大的晶体沉积。我们还检测到了一个微弱的信号存在。
descriptions.en: The superficial layer of surface ice on [From.GetName] covers an abnormally large crystal deposit. We are also detecting the presence of a faint signal.

sections.zh: [From.GetName]地表冰层的最上层覆盖着规模异常巨大的晶体沉积。我们还检测到了一个微弱的信号存在。
sections.en: The superficial layer of surface ice on [From.GetName] covers an abnormally large crystal deposit. We are also detecting the presence of a faint signal.

descriptions.zh: 我们发现了外形类似球体的高密度能量信号。建议进行更深入的调查。
descriptions.en: We have discovered powerful concentrated energy in the form of an orb. Investigation is advised.

sections.zh: 我们发现了外形类似球体的高密度能量信号。建议进行更深入的调查。
sections.en: We have discovered powerful concentrated energy in the form of an orb. Investigation is advised.

descriptions.zh: [From.Planet.GetName]的航拍图像显示，其迅速减少的植被可能表明，该行星表面存在一种未知的生命形式栖息在此。
descriptions.en: Aerial images taken of [From.Planet.GetName]'s rapidly diminishing vegetation could indicate the presence of an unidentified life form habiting its surface.

sections.zh: [From.Planet.GetName]的航拍图像显示，其迅速减少的植被可能表明，该行星表面存在一种未知的生命形式栖息在此。
sections.en: Aerial images taken of [From.Planet.GetName]'s rapidly diminishing vegetation could indicate the presence of an unidentified life form habiting its surface.

descriptions.zh: 暗淡的瑟顿星系潜藏着一处宇宙织构的裂痕。更不同寻常的是这个裂口本身正在收缩，似乎有什么东西或是什么人正在修复它。
descriptions.en: The dim Seddom system houses a tear in the fabric of the universe. Even more unusual, the tear itself is gradually shrinking, as if something or someone is working to repair it.

sections.zh: 暗淡的瑟顿星系潜藏着一处宇宙织构的裂痕。更不同寻常的是这个裂口本身正在收缩，似乎有什么东西或是什么人正在修复它。
sections.en: The dim Seddom system houses a tear in the fabric of the universe. Even more unusual, the tear itself is gradually shrinking, as if something or someone is working to repair it.

descriptions.zh: 在[from.Solar_System.GetName]恒星系中探测到了许多怪异的重力读数，从内小行星带到恒星系中心的荒芜行星四处闪烁着这些信号。
descriptions.en: Strange gravimetric readings have been detected throughout the [from.Solar_System.GetName] system, pulsing from the inner astroid belt to the desolate planet at the heart of the system.

sections.zh: 在[from.Solar_System.GetName]恒星系中探测到了许多怪异的重力读数，从内小行星带到恒星系中心的荒芜行星四处闪烁着这些信号。
sections.en: Strange gravimetric readings have been detected throughout the [from.Solar_System.GetName] system, pulsing from the inner astroid belt to the desolate planet at the heart of the system.

descriptions.zh: 在调查[From.GetName]的时候，我们发现了一种怪异的岩石形态，矗立在这颗本以为空无一物的荒凉行星上。
descriptions.en: While surveying [From.GetName], we uncovered a grotesque rock formation from what has been thought to be nothing but a barren planet.

sections.zh: 在调查[From.GetName]的时候，我们发现了一种怪异的岩石形态，矗立在这颗本以为空无一物的荒凉行星上。
sections.en: While surveying [From.GetName], we uncovered a grotesque rock formation from what has been thought to be nothing but a barren planet.

descriptions.zh: 对[From.GetName]地表厚重冰层多次进行扫描，仪器均产生了杂乱数据及异常干扰模式。冰层之下存在某种持续干扰探测设备的物体，我们建议进一步调查。
descriptions.en: Repeated attempts to scan the thick glacial layer covering [From.GetName] resulted in erratic data and unexpected interference patterns. Something beneath the ice keeps disrupting our equipment. Further investigation is advised.

sections.zh: 对[From.GetName]地表厚重冰层多次进行扫描，仪器均产生了杂乱数据及异常干扰模式。冰层之下存在某种持续干扰探测设备的物体，我们建议进一步调查。
sections.en: Repeated attempts to scan the thick glacial layer covering [From.GetName] resulted in erratic data and unexpected interference patterns. Something beneath the ice keeps disrupting our equipment. Further investigation is advised.

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName]附近突然探测到一处激增的辐射。调查时得多加小心。
descriptions.en: A significant spike in radiation has been detected in the vicinity of [From.GetName]. Proceed with caution when investigating.

sections.zh: [From.GetName]附近突然探测到一处激增的辐射。调查时得多加小心。
sections.en: A significant spike in radiation has been detected in the vicinity of [From.GetName]. Proceed with caution when investigating.
